description: A Dataset of Distribution and Characterization of Underground Wastewater Treatment Plants in China is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Shuyan Zhou, Hui Gong. Underground wastewater treatment plants (U-WWTPs) have emerged as a novel paradigm for urban wastewater pollutants management, offering benefits such as alleviating the Not-in-my-backyard (NIMBY) effect and utilizing land resources efficiently. China stands at the forefront, witnessing swift advancements in U-WWTP technology and deployment. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 243218 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
